description: Session context, the right column, the Bash call check, and Markdown formatting for the ~/cos record repository.

hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" != "$HOME/cos" ] || [ ! -d "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.beads" ] || { cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; bd prime; echo '## bd: in_progress'; bd list --status in_progress --limit 0 --json | jq -r '.[]? | [.id, .status, (.assignee // "-"), ((.labels // []) | map(select(startswith("project:"))) | join(",")), .title] | @tsv'; echo '## bd: 判断待ち'; bd human list --status open; echo '## bd: ready'; bd ready --exclude-type decision --limit 10 --json | jq -r '.[]? | [.id, .priority, ((.labels // []) | map(select(startswith("project:"))) | join(",")), .title] | @tsv'; echo '## bd: 件数'; bd count --by-status; echo '## threads: 最近の話題'; "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/thread-index --since 14d --limit 15 || true; }
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$HOME"/cos/*.md) rumdl fmt "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0
